messages:
maya: Heads-up — canary slice 3 showing p95 embeddings jump to ~820ms. Deploybot posted a signal at 4234567888 :warning:
deploybot: [alert] canary-embed-route p95=820ms (threshold=600ms), occurrence=3/5 min. Suggested action: consider rollback or reduce traffic. Autorevert=false (safety window).
sam: Thanks — is this correlated with the quantization change we rolled in last night?
era: I see a small uptick in cache-miss rate around same time, +12%. Could be cache invalidation on that kernel flag.
lina: Can we triage quickly? If it's cache warming, maybe a short pin and rollout tweak instead of full revert.
maya: Good call. Metrics: CPU on embeders unchanged, but KV cache hit dropped from 94% -> 81%. Logs show a handful of `kvcache: miss - shard 7` entries.
ops-oncall-bot: runbook reminder: if canary p95 > threshold for 10m or customer-facing endpoints impacted, escalate to manual rollback. Link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/rollback
sam: We have 6m of sustained >600ms. Ops call?
era: I prefer manual rollback to v3.4.1 — safer than flipping kernel flags mid-window. Lina, you OK with pinning dedicated pools?
lina: Yes. I'll draft the quick release-note blurb for the rollback and the customer-facing line: "minor perf regression addressed; rolling back to 3.4.1"
maya: Who has authority to trigger? @eric?
eric: I'm here. Let's do coordinated manual rollback. Plan: 1) pause canary traffic, 2) revert canary to v3.4.1, 3) monitor p95 & kvcache hits for 15m, 4) unpause. If any downstream fails, abort and escalate.
maya: Agreed. I will pause the canary slice now.
[deploybot] action: `pause-rollout --target=canary-slice-3 --by=maya`
maya: paused.
eric: Running revert now. Command below — will run staged so we can abort between hosts:
```
rollout revert --target=canary-slice-3 --to-version=v3.4.1 --staged=5 --reason="embed p95 spike"
```
eric: kicked it off, stage 1/5 started.
ops-oncall-bot: Reminder: notify cust-impact channel if rollback extended >30m.
sam: small note — let's pin dedicated pools to v3.4.1 to prevent autoscaling picking the new build. Lina, can you push that?
lina: On it. Pinned dedicated pools and updated internal release matrix.
[deploybot] update: stage 1/5 succeeded, stage 2/5 started.
maya: p95 down to 410ms on the canary instance from stage 1 — good sign. KV hit climbed to 88%.
eric: stage 3/5 succeeded, continuing.
[deploybot] update: rollback complete for canary-slice-3. All stages green.
maya: Monitoring for 15m window. So far stable.
ops-oncall-bot: Filing incident-lite ticket for tracking: INC-2024-0482 (perf regression, manual rollback).
lina: Release notes update pushed to `release-notes/drafts/2024-03-embed-fix.md` with rollback blurb and a short postmortem TODO.
sam: Customer comm: draft in #cust-comms for review. Keep it factual and short.
eric: Postmortem action items: 1) revert kernel flag rollout 2) add KV cache warmup for new shards 3) add canary rule: require KV hit >=90% before promoting.
maya: Thank you all. If canary stays stable, we'll schedule a controlled rollout of a patched build removing the offending flag. For now we mark release as reverted and pin. :thumbsup:
[deploybot] note: rollout metadata updated: release_state=reverted, pinned_version=v3.4.1, operator=eric
maya: closing thread, will ping if anything changes.
summary: Manual rollback executed for canary embeddings due to p95 regression; staged revert to v3.4.1, dedicated pools pinned, release notes and customer comms queued, incident ticket opened.
